prerequisites.requirement: Retain arbitrary packed u32 sign words through all4096 K terms, batching/strides; concrete IndexInput i=i is insufficient.
Track complete source/destination leases and LDS lifetime through all full-loop reuse generations.
Use real legal gfx1250 WMMA and independently derived complete fragment/dtype/accumulator maps; no MFMA relabel.
Preserve original runtime grid extent, packed XYZ IDs and selected-workgroup scope without claiming whole-device race freedom.
Model actual compiler-selected packed FP8 operands and all implicit/explicit scale bytes; no decoded F32 stand-in.
Retain actual OCP E4M3 bytes, exact finite decode, original packing and F16 output conversions.
Unsampled mathematical/exact integer checks for every original sparse index and independent dtype-aware CPU hardware references.
Required completion, replay-address retention, split-barrier publication and safe cross-wave consumption through every stage.
Compile genuine original-shape gfx1250 source with pinned compiler; assemble/link unchanged .s and pin metadata/tool hashes.
Demonstrate original full loop/output sizes within explicit CPU/RSS/time budgets; resource abort is incomplete.
Existing CLI/Python/config/expression/VC/graph/export/replay/profile/log/viewer/harness workflows at original case scope.
Signed external byte interpretation plus exact Q/K arithmetic and original one query/two key scales.
